description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewahamanduwa, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad Map No. 820010
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, property addresses, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership registration and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
